experiment: Study Manager #889 (F1 statistical baselines vs frozen DDM), plan v0.3

requirements.title: Periods and purge
requirements.description: Estimation / validation / final periods; origin time and target end must both lie inside the period.

requirements.title: Blocks, gap rule, target definition
requirements.description: 60-candle blocks, origin = last row, a step > 5 minutes is a gap, target = log C[t+60h]/C[t]; the origin set is also checked against an independent brute-force construction.

requirements.title: Information at the origin uses rows <= t only
requirements.description: ATR, block return, block RV and HAR features at block j depend only on rows up to t_j.

requirements.title: Learned state uses data before the month start
requirements.description: Monthly learned state (completed targets, GARCH/HAR parameters, residual pools, hour factors) is built only from data strictly before the month start.

requirements.title: Model samplers
requirements.description: B0-B8 and B4s: per-path sequential simulation, standardised t, HAR with separate residual and innovation laws; no read of data after the origin; deterministic.

requirements.title: CRPS, PIT, coverage, pinball
requirements.description: Fair CRPS (M=1000), plain CRPS, randomised PIT, central-interval hits, pinball losses; checked against brute force, analytic values and an independent recomputation.

requirements.title: Per-horizon validation selection
requirements.description: Best statistical model per horizon from B0-B7 on validation CRPS, 0.5% tie rule with complexity order; B8 and B4s excluded.

requirements.title: Delta_h, simultaneous band, labels, DM, Holm
requirements.description: Delta_h = (CRPS_DDM - CRPS_Stat)/CRPS_Stat (negative = DDM better); week-block joint bootstrap, max-t simultaneous band, label rules, Newey-West lag h+23, Holm as secondary.

requirements.title: DDM mapping from estimation windows only
requirements.description: Bucket edges and bucket->candidate mapping from estimation-period windows; forward 1001 closes gap-free and inside the estimation period; production stage_map calls build_mapping with the production characterise/select functions and defaults.

requirements.title: DDM horizon definition
requirements.description: DDM cumulative return spans exactly 60h candle steps like the real target (audit defect D1 fixed).

requirements.title: Leak test implementation, perturbation method, pass condition
requirements.description: leak_job replaces all data after the origin by random numbers, rebuilds every derived array, keeps the learned state fixed, and requires bit-identical samples for all statistical models and DDM seeds; the test shows a deliberately leaky sampler is detected.

requirements.title: Leak test on the real ensembles (execution-time gate)
requirements.description: Leak test on the real ensembles: run after ensemble generation and before any score; failure stops the study. Enforced in code: stage_score refuses unless leak_test.json passed on this commit and on exactly these mapping/ensemble files (require_leak_pass). Post-run gate: must be passed before results are approved.

requirements.title: Seeds and determinism
requirements.description: Samplers seeded by (model, block); determinism of the whole scored month; fixed DDM, mapping, PIT and bootstrap seeds.

requirements.title: Scoring chain and persistence on the production path
requirements.description: month_job calls score_month with the loaded objects; stage_score aggregates and writes with write_scores; identical origin sets across models; result files re-loadable and analysed.

requirements.title: Environment pinned
requirements.description: arch==8.0.0 in requirements; installation changed no other package (pip dry run).

tests: pip install --dry-run arch==8.0.0 showed only arch added (manual check recorded in the audit report)

requirements.title: PIT uncertainty by 100 re-randomisations
requirements.description: pit_lo/pit_w stored per origin; the final analysis reports mean/SD of the KS distance and the largest histogram-bin SD over 100 repeats; exactly 0 without ties.

requirements.title: Executed state equals the audited commit; no bypass
requirements.description: Every stage script calls guard_main first (measures HEAD, every loaded repository module, input hashes -> state_hash; --preflight prints it) and end_run last. It refuses unless a Study Manager gate approval for this node, HEAD and state_hash is present and passing (Stage C approved, commit match, clean workspace, no unresolved critical), and always refuses modified or untracked loaded repository files. No environment variable or flag bypasses it.

tests: backend/tests/unit/test_f1_guard.py (16 tests incl. wrong-approval matrix, environment variables cannot bypass, untracked loaded module, preload of lazy modules, end_run detects change, stage scripts route through the guard)
manual: preflight and refused run without approval on the real repository

requirements.title: Old versus rebuilt mapping effect
requirements.description: Sensitivity/secondary evaluation of the look-ahead mapping versus the rebuilt mapping. Not a blocker for the primary analysis; must be done or declared not done before the study is reported as complete.

requirements.title: Supplementary period 2022-09..12
requirements.description: Auxiliary evaluation on HistData (source alignment unchecked). Not a blocker for the primary analysis; must be done or declared not done before completion.

requirements.title: M1-based GARCH comparison
requirements.description: Separate additional comparison declared not run in the plan.

requirements.title: full_characterize, atlas and select_ensemble use the same statistics
requirements.description: The statistics computed for a real window equal independent numpy definitions (log returns, population moments, Pearson kurtosis, unadjusted ACF); an atlas row is reproduced by the current code; select_ensemble maps the statistics to the right atlas columns and flags out-of-range volatility.

requirements.title: Statistical limitations stated
requirements.description: Weekly bootstrap does not model adjacent-week dependence; HAR independence assumption; DDM-only frozen mapping asymmetry; partially known final period; provisional margin; ATR definition; atlas 999 vs 1000 returns. Documented as interpretation limits to be repeated with every result.

known_limitations: DDM ensemble frozen on the estimation period while the other models are re-estimated monthly (declared asymmetry).
ATR uses 59 absolute differences of the 60 closes (earlier code used 60 including one future close).
Week-block bootstrap does not model dependence across adjacent weeks.
HAR-RV assumes independence of log-RV residual and return innovation.
stage_map with the real atlas and the real full_characterize is covered by a wiring test (functions passed) and by an earlier real run, not by a numerical test of full_characterize.
Stopped earlier ensemble job may still have worker processes running (kill was denied); its old work directory is not used.
